joy.prompt: Edit ONLY the facial emotion of the FIRST image, the approved forward-gazing full-body sheep/ram character. Output ONE independent 1024 x 1536 transparent PNG portrait, not a sheet. First image controls the entire silhouette, body, hand positions, book and hanging keys, hair braid, huge dark curled horns, clothing and boots. Keep every body/prop position and camera/framing fixed. Use second image ONLY as a guide to the joy expression, not its pose, stars or extra decorations. Give a warm small open-mouth smile and pleased lifted eyebrows, keeping BOTH golden eyes OPEN and directly meeting camera/viewer/father. Never glance sideways or down to book. Do not add star/sparkle/heart/sweat symbols or effects. Preserve charcoal face, ivory wool, green shawl, gray robe and gold accessories; same chunky pixel style, thick dark stepped outlines, broad flat colors, 2-3 hard shadow tones. Transparent background must be completely empty alpha zero outside silhouette, NO dark haze, NO halo or shadows, NO white sticker outline, no text. Preserve entire full body inside frame.
joy.visual_review: 정면 양눈·감정 구분·전신/소품 보존 확인; 밝은 배경 투명 가장자리는 root 독립 검수

angry.prompt:

First image controls exact full-body framing, all hair/ear/horn shapes, clothing, body pose, hand positions and props. Keep the entire body and both feet in frame with same margins. Use image TWO only as the face-emotion guide, do not copy its body pose or shift, close or remove any book/lantern/keys. BOTH eyes must remain OPEN and both pupils look directly out toward the viewer/camera/father, never sideways or down at props. Same original character age/species/sex presentation/colors. Faithful chunky pixel game art, thick dark stepped outlines, flat color regions and 2-3 hard shadow tones. No smooth vector outlines, no airbrush, no 3D. No white border or sticker, no text, no symbols, no background, no haze or exterior shadow; fully empty alpha zero outside silhouette.
Clearly angry but restrained: inward-lowered brows, open focused golden eyes meeting camera, a displeased closed-mouth frown. Keep large open book and gold keys exactly in neutral positions.
